descriptionChirho: Qal stative sense describing something as being or becoming long in physical extent or temporal duration.
Hifil causative sense meaning to extend or lengthen one's days, lifespan, or time in the land, the most frequent use of this root.
Hifil causative sense meaning to make physically long or stretch out something (cords, furrows, tongue), involving spatial extension of a concrete object.
Hifil sense meaning to prolong or draw out an action, state, or sound over time, emphasizing ongoing duration or endurance rather than lifespan.
Hifil sense meaning to make slow, tarry, or postpone, often implying patience or forbearance in delaying an expected action.
